scope: H11 bounded project candidate listing, transient cooperative cancellation, and safe selected text read
changes: project_files requires fresh UUID requestId, main-window caller and fixed Failure.code; returns paths plus distinct truncated/partial/cancelled, counts, limits, reasons and exclusions.

read_dir is consumed incrementally; total/per-directory entry budgets precede next(), directory queue/depth, file count, UTF-8 path bytes and elapsed scan work are bounded. Only the bounded returned subset is sorted.
Names are never lossy-converted or backslashes rewritten. Unrepresentable/control/backslash names are omitted with partial coverage. Fixed excluded directory names are returned explicitly.

A root read failure rejects; subtree failures remain partial. Queued directory no-follow identity is rechecked before enumeration and before publishing its candidates; stable replacements are rejected.

Exact UUID cancellation flags are memory-only (64 entries, inactive retention 300s); live workers cannot be evicted. Reuse of an observed UUID and cancel-before-start are rejected within that observation period.
Existing file_read_check owns the actual two-worker admission and ActivityPermit through real blocking work. 15s observer timeout or dropped IPC never establishes OS termination.
project_file_read reuses file_access root/relative handles, 256KiB+1 bounded read, stamps and root/path identity recheck; rejects redirection, changed files, oversize and non-UTF8 bytes.

limitsAndUnverified: Not a complete project index: fixed exclusions, explicit traversal limits and concurrent filesystem changes remain visible coverage boundaries.

Directory enumeration remains pathname-based with before/after no-follow identity checks; not a handle-relative atomic tree snapshot or protection against every instantaneous swap-and-restore race. Selected bytes use strict owned handles, and sending retains the existing attachment recheck.
One OS metadata/read_dir/read call cannot be forcibly interrupted. 5s cooperative scan deadline and 15s response observation are not a wall-clock guarantee that OS work ended.
UUID retention is bounded, not a permanent replay ledger; frontend must always use a new UUID and retire old owners. Cancellation acknowledgement alone never means completed cancellation.
Actual tests here ran on this macOS account. The real chmod permission fixture requires unprivileged execution; Windows/reparse behavior is not established by this run.
No full Rust suite, full frontend suite, installed app, Agent, database or model/auth operation was run in this subtask. Root/verification own frontend, shared integration and installed verification.
